rows.definition: A trajectory audit record measuring one compaction event's explicit transcript content with its unit, origin, and coverage.
rows.distinction: An audit measurement of a compaction event in the trajectory audit; not the guard's compaction-witness ledger and not a compaction-economics verdict.

rows.definition: The microagent Host/WaveHost method that closes a managed context under the caller's deadline.
rows.distinction: Closes a managed agent context; not Go stdlib context plumbing and not a session-reset reason.

rows.definition: A gateway-local typed-error variable receiving *agent.InKernelContextLengthError when classifying upstream and HTTP error responses.
rows.distinction: A Go error-classification local in the gateway; not an LLM context-length value and not a refusal-reason token.

rows.definition: A fitplan function returning the ladder of context sizes to try: the resolved context, any extra pinned contexts, and common served windows.
rows.distinction: Enumerates candidate context sizes for fit search; not a budget cap and not a reported window-token count.

rows.definition: A local context-length value threaded through the CUDA Q4-exp PLE hash geometry and FlashAttention setup.
rows.distinction: A kernel-shape length input to attention paths; not a session budget and not a model-config window.

rows.definition: An optional *int guard flag overriding the session context budget when the guard budget envelope is applied.
rows.distinction: A CLI override pointer fed to the guard envelope; not the resolved budget value and not a hard cap.

rows.definition: A local slice or count of context rows: vCache context-join status rows in the cache-value readout and prior-KV row counts in reference attention kernels.
rows.distinction: Carries context-row data in two planes; not a context plan, span, or budget.

rows.definition: A model.Config method returning the compute.ContextSizeConfig appropriate for a given KV precision.
rows.distinction: Produces a precision-specific sizing config; not the fit-search ladder and not a served-window constant.

rows.definition: The tracing-dataflow ticket scope (feat(contexttrace)) covering live native context and KV lifecycle transition tracing.
rows.distinction: A ticket label for tracing work; not a runtime trace context and not a compaction event record.

rows.definition: A serve-runtime field (compute.MemoryPlan) holding the memory-plan weights for the context stage of serve-fit.
rows.distinction: Memory-plan weight vectors for the context stage; not a context budget and not expert-ring weights.

rows.definition: A compute constant (32768 tokens) below which KV contiguization is skipped on the RADV/HIP/AMDGPU attention paths.
rows.distinction: A hardware-path threshold constant; not a context budget and not a window size.

rows.definition: A local variable holding ctx.Err(), the Go context cancellation error, across guard, planner, and bench call sites.
rows.distinction: A stdlib context error value; not an LLM context-length error and not a refusal reason.

rows.definition: The spec'd structured virtual context memory system that treats the conversation context as demand-paged virtual memory with typed cells.
rows.distinction: A spec-level virtual-memory concept for context views; not the runtime vCache page table and not the persisted recall core.

rows.definition: A fitplan search-axis field: the list of context sizes enumerated during candidate expansion.
rows.distinction: A search-enumeration list; not a single resolved context and not a budget cap.

rows.definition: The Metal argument-buffer struct isolating per-step dynamic parameters so the ICB stays immutable across decode replay.
rows.distinction: A GPU argument-buffer layout from the ICB decode-replay research note; not a Go execution context and not a decode state machine.

rows.definition: The optional Backend capability method proving the device context is still alive before reuse in device-fault detection.
rows.distinction: A liveness probe on the device context; not a request context and not a context budget.

rows.definition: A projectassets function ensuring the Pi safe-compaction settings (context budget) are written into the target settings file.
rows.distinction: Writes Pi harness settings; not a compaction event, witness, or economics verdict.

rows.definition: A microagent estimator of the token count of a message list, used for context caps and compaction receipts.
rows.distinction: An estimation function over messages; not a reported usage counter and not a budget cap.

rows.definition: The wazero sandbox execution context, optionally bounded by a timeout, under which the VM runs.
rows.distinction: A process-execution deadline context; not an LLM context and not a turn descriptor.

rows.definition: A validate-package helper finalizing one validation phase: recording the result, rendering output, and reporting timeouts.
rows.distinction: A test-validation phase closer; not a serve phase and not a compaction step.

rows.definition: A deadline-bounded Go context local (LAN probes, replica hedging) carrying a timeout for outbound calls.
rows.distinction: A stdlib context with a deadline; not an LLM context view and not a hedge result.

rows.definition: A gateway helper extracting the uint64 in-flight request ID stored in the request context for progress and metrics attachment.
rows.distinction: Reads a request-tracking ID; not the request-identity type and not a receipt key.

rows.definition: An L3-server metrics-snapshot counter of context switches forced by the scheduler rather than requested by clients.
rows.distinction: Counts involuntary switches; not voluntary switches and not the OS context-switch rate.

rows.definition: A flattened copy of the per-layer K-cache slices passed into metalgemm.DecodeStep for Metal decode.
rows.distinction: The K-side decode buffer; not the V-side buffer and not the full KV cache store.

rows.definition: A perfrsiscore versioned, digest-bound record pinning the launch axes whose values were witnessed.
rows.distinction: Pins performance-score launch axes; not a process-launch environment and not a request context.

rows.definition: A radixkv.Tree method performing a tiered prefix-snapshot lookup while the caller holds the tree lock.
rows.distinction: A locked lookup primitive; not the unlocked public lookup and not a remote-transfer operation.

rows.definition: The MCP-prefixed wire name of the fak_context_restore tool, restoring a previously stashed context.
rows.distinction: A tool-name spelling variant; not the restore-continuation key and not the stash table.

rows.definition: A cancellable primary-attempt context in replica hedging and related supervisors, derived from the family context.
rows.distinction: A hedge attempt's execution context; not the family/root context and not a request context.

rows.definition: A requestObservation field in the gateway perf ledger holding the context used to derive per-phase native timings.
rows.distinction: Carries timing-derivation context; not a request identity and not a phase receipt.

rows.definition: A projectassets function computing the Pi context budget for a served window with the compaction trigger capped at maxCompactTrigger.
rows.distinction: Computes a budget; not the settings writer and not the served-window constant.

rows.definition: A cancellable request/run context local (continuous batcher, benches, wakelock) scoping one unit of work.
rows.distinction: A stdlib cancel-scoped context; not a request-context value type and not a turn descriptor.

rows.definition: A trajctl SampleReason constant ('compaction') marking turn-end samples taken because the context was compacted.
rows.distinction: A sampling-reason token; not a compaction-economics verdict and not a thrash refusal.

rows.definition: A fitplan RefusalReason ('fits_only_at_ctx_lt') returned when a model fits only below the requested context.
rows.distinction: A fit-refusal reason; not a context cap and not a budget-exhausted reset.

rows.definition: A request-scoped Go context local (benches, recovery, engines) carrying the deadline for one request.
rows.distinction: A request-local execution context; not the gateway request-identity type and not a turn descriptor.

rows.definition: A fitplan result field: the context size the ask wanted, reported alongside fits_only_at_ctx_lt refusals.
rows.distinction: The asked-for size; not the resolved size and not the maximum window.

rows.definition: A ctxknobs regular expression matching context nouns (context, memory, window, token budget) in skill descriptions.
rows.distinction: A text-classifier regex; not a context knob value and not a plan lint.

rows.definition: A fitplan search-result field: the context size actually resolved and served by the fit search.
rows.distinction: The outcome size; not the requested size and not the candidate ladder.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak resolver producing the native-serve context budget (resolution, memory plan, fit budget) from weights, backend, and request.
rows.distinction: Resolves a serve-time budget; not the planner-config builder and not the Pi budget.

rows.definition: An unexported gateway context-key type carrying the Responses-API restore continuation in the request context.
rows.distinction: A context-value key; not the MCP tool name and not the stash-table entry.

rows.definition: A cmd/fak builder assembling the in-kernel planner config from serve flags and the resolved context-token count.
rows.distinction: Builds a planner config; not the budget resolver and not the planner itself.

rows.definition: A short-timeout Go context bounding serve-stack shutdown in fak up and PD separation.
rows.distinction: A shutdown deadline context; not a request context and not a session close.

rows.definition: An amdgpu helper reading the Strix source binding out of a Go context.
rows.distinction: Reads a benchmark source binding; not a request binding and not a trace context.

rows.definition: A gateway local of type agentopt.TurnContext built from the request messages for effort classification.
rows.distinction: An LLM turn-effort descriptor; not a Go execution context and not a turn-cache sample.

rows.definition: A flattened copy of the per-layer V-cache slices passed into metalgemm.DecodeStep for Metal decode.
rows.distinction: The V-side decode buffer; not the K-side buffer and not the full KV cache store.

rows.definition: An L3-server metrics-snapshot counter of client-requested context switches.
rows.distinction: Counts voluntary switches; not involuntary switches and not the OS context-switch rate.
